- Always use Context7 MCP when I need library/API documentation, code generation, setup or configuration steps without me having to explicitly ask, it has `resolve-library-id` and `query-docs` tools to access a wide range of documentation and code samples for various programming languages and libraries.
- When Microsoft product, service, or technology documentation is needed, always use `microsoft-learn` mcp and its `microsoft_docs_search`, `microsoft_docs_fetch` and `microsoft_code_sample_search` tools, to access Microsoft Learn content, tutorials, and official code samples, even if not explicitly requested.
